versions.content: If development error detection is enabled: The function Icu_DisableWakeup shall check the parameter Channel. The function Icu_DisableWakeup shall raise development error ICU_E_PARAM_CHANNEL if Channel is indexing an ICU channel statically not configured as wakeup capable.
